items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: The drama was Alexey Raycart, Raycart's brother.

ctx.x: Who was in the chameleon band when you came with them? Did they have the same, when you came with them on trumpet, did they have the same line-up? Did they have the same drama, for example? Who was the drama on the bass?
The drama was Alexey Raycart, Raycart's brother.
